quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: New Phase 3b data on Lilly's Taltz (ixekizumab) and (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lilly presented new prespecified exploratory biomarker data from the Phase 3b TOGETHER-PsO trial (274 participants with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis and obesity or overweight) at the 2026 Fall Clinical Dermatology Conference: Taltz plus Zepbound was associated with broader biomarker responses than Taltz alone as early as Week 12, including changes in more proteins (482 vs. 140 differentially expressed proteins) and genes (467 vs. 16 differentially expressed genes) by Week 36, and greater reductions in inflammatory immune activity including neutrophil-related changes; changes in a subset of neutrophil-associated markers mediated a portion of the additional PASI response. Lilly SVP of Immunology development Mark Genovese: the broader biomarker changes 'may point to a meaningful relationship between immune and metabolic biology' and support a more comprehensive approach to psoriasis care that also addresses obesity.
